results_due: late January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (28 Oct to 6 Nov)
reasoning: Q2 revenue fell 8.5% on the quarter to ₹1,433 Cr as index-options premium ADTV dropped from ₹29,615 Cr to ₹22,531 Cr. October's premium ADTV was a record ₹35,481 Cr (57% above the Q2 average), cash-equity ADTV hit a record and a record 71 IPOs came in H1, so Q3 should recover.
Revenue is less than proportional to options premium (other lines are steadier); we assume +15% on the quarter to ₹1,650 Cr (+33% on Q3 FY26's ₹1,244 Cr).
Margin: management calls 67-68% sustainable; Screener's Q2 operating margin was 68%. We use 67.5%. PAT was 56% of revenue in Q2.
risks: Options volumes fade after October's record
Treasury and other income swings affect PAT
caveat: Screener's operating profit (₹973 Cr in Q2) is slightly lower than the company's operating EBITDA including core SGF contribution.
